title: Deployable cross-sectional swing scorer plan (planned, not yet built)
scope_if_proceed: Freeze the winning Alpha V3 feature set + model from the walk-forward.
Wrap a stateless scorer that ingests local price/volume features only.
Add a survivorship-free universe and re-validate on a fully OOS hold-out.
Build a risk engine that converts rankings into controlled long-only / long-flat positions (no leverage, no options/futures/FX).
hard_constraints: Survivorship bias must be resolved before trusting absolute returns.
No orders, no broker execution, no automation, no GCP deploy in 5-F1 research.
Preview-only; manual review; paper trading only.
if_not_ready: Keep the Phase 5-C price-only baseline; iterate on features / regime modeling before committing to a deployable scorer.
